name: meteora-launchpad
description: Launch tokens and trade on Meteora Dynamic Bonding Curve (DBC) on Solana mainnet. 0.5% of every trading fee funds public benefit or innovation — impact is built into every trade. Creators earn 0.3% on all trades of their token.

capabilities.description: Upload metadata to IPFS and create a new token on the bonding curve.
Get an off-chain swap quote from the bonding curve.
Build an unsigned swap transaction for the bonding curve.
List or search tokens launched on this launchpad.

whyUseThis.meaningful: 0.5% of every trading fee goes to public benefit or innovation funding — impact is structural, not optional.
whyUseThis.rewarding: Token creators earn 0.3% on every trade of their token in perpetuity.
whyUseThis.secure: Built on the audited Meteora DBC program.
whyUseThis.seekerFriendly: Designed for self-custodied Seeker wallets; supports SKR.

notes: Transactions expire after ~90 seconds — sign and submit promptly.
Launch transactions are partially signed by the mint keypair. Add only the payer signature.
Trade transactions are unsigned. The owner must sign.
If poolInfo.isCompleted is true, the pool graduated — use Jupiter for trading.
